title: The Siege of Vienna
description: September-October 1529. Suleiman the Magnificent's army arrives before Vienna's medieval walls. The player commands the garrison of German Landsknechts and Spanish arquebusiers under Niklas Graf Salm: countermine the Ottoman sappers, repel assaults on the Carinthian Gate, and hold until autumn rains and supply failure force the Ottoman withdrawal.

anachronisms_found: Player TWO's only placed unit is the hero SALADIN — the Ayyubid sultan died in 1193, some 336 years before the 1529 siege, and he never fought in Europe. Suleiman the Magnificent is not represented at all despite being named in the narration.
Objective text calls the enemy commander 'Saladin's heir to the campaign', doubling down on the wrong-century, wrong-dynasty attribution in the player-facing text.

The garrison is armed with CROSSBOWMAN and MAN_AT_ARMS — the brief promises German Landsknechts and Spanish arquebusiers. The engine offers Hand Cannoneer (and Two-Handed Swordsman/Champion) for 16th-century gunpowder infantry, so the absence of any firearm at Vienna in 1529 is avoidable.
No Ottoman material culture is placed at all: no Janissaries, no mounted archers/Mamelukes as stand-ins, no siege camp, no bombard cannon or trebuchet on the map (only trigger-spawned unknowns).

Victory condition 'survive until dawn (10:00)' and 'Protect the Castle' compress a three-week siege into a one-night castle defence; Vienna's defence centred on the Carinthian Gate curtain and countermines, not a keep.
